questions.explanation_zh: 第二段指出訂金為預估總額的20%，預估總額為$1,045（$900＋$85＋$60），20%即為$209，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What will happen if Ms. Berglund cancels on November 3?
questions.question_zh: 如果伯格倫女士在11月3日取消，會發生什麼事?
options: She will pay the full estimated total
She will receive a full refund of her deposit
She will be asked to reschedule the move for free
She will lose half of her deposit
questions.explanation_zh: 搬家日是11月7日，11月3日取消僅提前四天，不足七天；表單規定七天內取消者會損失一半訂金，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: The word "forfeit" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "forfeit" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "forfeit half of the deposit" 指客戶必須放棄、拿不回一半的訂金，與 "give up" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (B)。

passages.title: Letter from Pinecrest Public Library

meta.label: From:
meta.value: Evelyn Thorsen, Programs Coordinator, Pinecrest Public Library

paragraphs: Dear Mr. Halvorsen,

On behalf of Pinecrest Public Library, I am pleased to extend an invitation for you to speak at our annual Local Authors Night on Thursday, November 20, at 6:30 p.m. in the Hartley Room. Your recent novel, The Salt Road, has been widely discussed by our reading groups, and we would be delighted to have you share the story behind it with our community.

Each featured author will speak for about twenty minutes and then take questions from the audience. We are able to offer an honorarium of $300 as well as reimbursement of up to $100 in travel expenses with receipts.
Please let me know by October 20 whether you are able to attend. If so, kindly send a short biography of no more than 75 words for our printed program.

Sincerely,
Evelyn Thorsen
Programs Coordinator, Pinecrest Public Library

passages.title: E-mail: Reply to Local Authors Night Invitation

meta.label: Subject:
meta.value: Re: Invitation to Local Authors Night

paragraphs: Dear Ms. Thorsen,

Thank you for your kind invitation. I would be honored to take part in Local Authors Night. Unfortunately, I have a publisher's event in the city on the evening of November 20. Would it be possible to hold the event on Friday, November 21, instead? I understand if that is difficult to arrange.
I have attached a short biography as you requested. I would also appreciate a projector for a brief slide presentation and a small table where I can sell copies of my novel after the talk.

Best wishes,
Gunnar Halvorsen

questions.question_en: Why did Ms. Thorsen write the letter?
questions.question_zh: 索爾森女士為什麼寫這封信?
options: To request a refund for an event
To invite an author to speak at an event
To order copies of a novel
questions.explanation_zh: 信的第二段表示她代表圖書館邀請對方在年度的 Local Authors Night 演講，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: How much could Mr. Halvorsen receive from the library at most?
questions.question_zh: Halvorsen 先生最多可以從圖書館獲得多少錢?
questions.explanation_zh: 信的第三段提到酬勞為300美元，另可核實報銷最多100美元的交通費用，合計最多400美元，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: Why did Mr. Halvorsen send the e-mail?
questions.question_zh: Halvorsen 先生為什麼寄這封電子郵件?
options: To accept and ask for a different date
To ask for a larger payment
To request a tour of the library
questions.explanation_zh: 電子郵件中他表示願意參加，但因11月20日晚上有出版社活動，詢問能否改到11月21日，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What does Mr. Halvorsen ask the library to provide?
questions.question_zh: Halvorsen 先生要求圖書館提供什麼?
options: A projector and a table for book sales
A printed copy of the program
questions.explanation_zh: 電子郵件第三段提到他希望有投影機播放簡報，以及一張可以在演講後販售小說的小桌子，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: The word "extend" in paragraph 2 of the letter is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 信件第二段中的 "extend" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "extend an invitation" 是「發出邀請」的意思，與 "offer" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: What did Mr. Halvorsen do that Ms. Thorsen had requested?
questions.question_zh: Halvorsen 先生做了哪件索爾森女士所要求的事?
questions.explanation_zh: 信中第四段要求如果出席就附上簡短的個人簡介，而電子郵件中他表示已依要求附上簡介，因此答案是 (B)。

passages.title: Ironwood Fitness Club – Grand Reopening Offer
paragraphs: After a four-month renovation, Ironwood Fitness Club is reopening its doors on Saturday, November 7, with a brand-new 25-meter swimming pool, a larger strength-training floor, and a studio for cycling and yoga classes. Our friendly trainers are ready to help members of every level reach their goals.

To celebrate, we are offering special rates to new members who join between November 7 and November 30. The $75 enrollment fee will be waived, and your first month will be half price. Members who sign up for a 12-month plan will also receive three complimentary sessions with a personal trainer. Monthly plans are $39 for individuals and $65 for couples.

Do you work for a local company? Ask about our corporate program: when five or more employees of the same company join together, each receives an additional 10 percent off the monthly rate. Existing members keep their current rates and may bring a guest for free every Saturday in November. Visit our front desk Monday through Friday from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. to tour the facility and sign up.

questions.question_en: What is being advertised?
questions.question_zh: 這則廣告在宣傳什麼?
options: Special membership rates for a reopened club
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告開頭說明健身俱樂部整修後重新開幕，並在第二段提供新會員的優惠費率，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: Mr. and Mrs. Yoon join on November 10 with the couples plan. How much will they pay for the first month?
questions.question_zh: 尹先生夫婦在11月10日加入雙人方案，第一個月需付多少錢?
questions.explanation_zh: 11月10日在優惠期間內，75美元入會費免收，第一個月半價；雙人方案月費$65，半價為$32.50，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a new feature of the club?
questions.question_zh: 下列何者「沒有」被提及為俱樂部的新設施?
questions.explanation_zh: 第一段列出新的25公尺游泳池、更大的重量訓練區，以及單車與瑜伽教室，並沒有提到兒童遊戲區，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: The word "complimentary" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "complimentary" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "three complimentary sessions with a personal trainer" 指贈送三堂私人教練課，即免費提供，與 "free of charge" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (B)。

passages.title: Notice: Quantelle Cloud Upgrade to Version 5.2
paragraphs: Quantelle Software will upgrade its cloud accounting platform to Version 5.2 on Saturday, October 24. During the upgrade, all Quantelle services, including the web application, the mobile app, and automatic bank feeds, will be unavailable from 10:00 p.m. on Saturday until 4:00 a.m. on Sunday, October 25.

Version 5.2 introduces faster invoice processing, a redesigned dashboard, and an automatic payroll reminder tool. To keep using the mobile app, customers must install the 5.2 version of the app by October 31. Mobile app versions older than 5.0 will stop working after the upgrade.

We recommend that customers complete any time-sensitive tasks before the upgrade window begins. Details about the support plans and upgrade assistance available to you can be found on our Support Center page. We apologize for any inconvenience and thank you for your continued trust.

passages.title: E-mail: Concerns About the October 24 Upgrade
paragraphs: To the Quantelle Support Team,

I received your notice about the October 24 upgrade, and I have two concerns. First, our weekend crew is paid every other Saturday, and our payroll is scheduled to be processed at 11:00 p.m. that night. Because the platform will be offline, I am afraid that our employees' pay will be delayed. Second, the six tablets in our workshop are still running version 4.8 of the mobile app, and I am not sure what we should do with them before the upgrade.

We have subscribed to your Business plan for three years, and I would appreciate any guidance you can offer. I would also like to attend the training webinar if it is not held during our production hours.

Sincerely,
Ilse Petrova
Operations Manager, Wickersham Cabinetry

passages.title: Quantelle Support Center: Plans and Upgrade Assistance
paragraphs: Upgrade assistance by support plan. Basic plan: e-mail support on weekdays from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Business plan: all Basic benefits, plus telephone support and a free pre-upgrade payroll export, which lets you send payroll files to your bank manually while the platform is offline. Enterprise plan: all Business benefits, plus a dedicated account manager.

Updating the mobile app. Devices running a version older than 5.0 cannot be updated through the app store. On these devices, the old app must be deleted and the new version installed as a fresh app, which takes about ten minutes per device. Your data stays safe in the cloud.
Free webinar. Join us on Wednesday, October 21, at 12:30 p.m. for a 45-minute introduction to the new dashboard. A recording will be available the following day.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the notice?
questions.question_zh: 這則通知的目的為何?
options: To announce the retirement of a product
To introduce a new customer support plan
To inform customers of a scheduled upgrade and service interruption
To invite customers to a training event
questions.explanation_zh: 通知說明平台將於10月24日升級到5.2版，期間所有服務無法使用，目的是告知客戶排定的升級與服務中斷，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: How long will Quantelle services be unavailable during the upgrade?
questions.question_zh: 升級期間 Quantelle 的服務將停止多久?
questions.explanation_zh: 通知第一段指出服務從週六晚上10點到週日凌晨4點無法使用，共計六小時，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT listed as a feature of Version 5.2?
questions.question_zh: 下列何者「不是」5.2版的功能?
questions.explanation_zh: 通知第二段列出更快的發票處理、重新設計的儀表板與自動薪資提醒工具，並未提到降低訂閱價格，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: Why did Ms. Petrova write the e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 佩特洛娃女士為什麼寫這封電子郵件?
options: To ask for help with concerns about the upgrade
To request a new mobile app feature
questions.explanation_zh: 電子郵件中她提出對薪資發放與平板電腦行動App兩項疑慮，並希望獲得指引，可見是為了就升級問題尋求協助，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: The word "guidance" in the e-mail is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 電子郵件中的 "guidance" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "I would appreciate any guidance you can offer" 指希望對方提供建議或指導，與 "advice" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What can Ms. Petrova do to make sure her weekend crew is paid on time?
questions.question_zh: 佩特洛娃女士可以怎麼做，確保週末員工準時領到薪水?
options: Use the free payroll export before the upgrade
questions.explanation_zh: 通知說明10月24日晚上10點起停機，而她的薪資作業排在當晚11點（電子郵件）；她訂閱的是 Business plan，網頁指出該方案可使用免費的升級前薪資匯出，在平台離線時手動將檔案寄給銀行，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: What should the staff at Wickersham Cabinetry do with the workshop tablets?
questions.question_zh: Wickersham Cabinetry 的員工應如何處理工坊的平板電腦?
options: Update the app through the app store
Delete the old app and install the new version
Wait until the platform returns on October 25
Replace the tablets with new devices
questions.explanation_zh: 平板使用4.8版App（電子郵件），而通知說明5.0版以前的App在升級後將無法使用；網頁指出這類裝置無法透過應用程式商店更新，必須刪除舊版後重新安裝新版，因此答案是 (B)。

passages.title: Memo
paragraphs: Starting Monday, October 27, all warehouse staff at Calderwood Distribution will use handheld scanners to confirm each order picked, replacing the paper pick lists we have used until now. The new system will reduce errors and allow customer service to track orders in real time.

Training sessions will be held in the break room on October 21, 22, and 23 at 7:30 a.m. and 3:30 p.m. Each session lasts 45 minutes, and attendance is mandatory for all pickers and packers. Supervisors will sign up their team members on the schedule posted outside the time-clock area by October 17. Employees who cannot attend any of the sessions must contact me directly by October 15.

Paper pick lists will remain available as a backup during the first week, but they will be collected on November 3 and will no longer be accepted. Please report any scanner malfunction to your supervisor immediately. I appreciate your cooperation during this transition.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the memo?
questions.question_zh: 這份備忘錄的目的為何?
options: To announce a new warehouse location
To inform employees of a new scanning procedure
To report a decrease in shipping errors
questions.explanation_zh: 備忘錄開頭說明從10月27日起，所有倉儲人員將改用手持掃描器確認揀貨，取代紙本揀貨單，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Who is required to attend the training sessions?
questions.question_zh: 誰必須參加訓練課程?
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段明確指出所有揀貨員與包裝員都必須出席訓練，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What should employees who cannot attend any session do?
questions.question_zh: 無法參加任何一場訓練的員工該怎麼做?
options: Sign up on the posted schedule by October 17
Ask a supervisor to scan for them
Keep using paper pick lists permanently
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段提到無法參加任何場次的員工，必須在10月15日前直接聯絡 Teague 先生，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: What will happen on November 3?
questions.question_zh: 11月3日會發生什麼事?
options: Customer service will start tracking orders.
Paper pick lists will no longer be accepted.
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到紙本揀貨單會在11月3日被收回，之後不再受理，因此答案是 (D)。

passages.title: Cedarline Travel – Autumn Escape Packages
paragraphs: Turn the quiet season into your best vacation of the year! Cedarline Travel is offering two escape packages for travelers who book before October 31. Each package includes round-trip airfare from Eastbrook Regional Airport, hotel accommodations, daily breakfast, and airport transfers.
Kyoto Temple Trail: 7 days, $2,350 per person. Tuscany Table & Vine: 6 days, $1,890 per person. Prices are based on double occupancy. Extra nights may be added at $95 per room per night.

Reserve with a $200 per-person deposit by October 31 and receive $150 off your total booking (one discount per booking, not per person). Deposits are refundable within 14 days of payment. Travel insurance is optional and can be added for $60 per person. All departures take place between November 15 and December 12, subject to availability. Call us or visit our office to speak with a travel consultant.

passages.title: E-mail: Question About the Tuscany Package
paragraphs: Dear Cedarline Travel,

My wife and I are interested in the Tuscany Table & Vine package, and we would like to depart on November 20. I know that the offer ends on October 31, but I cannot confirm my vacation days with my employer until October 30, so I will probably book on the last possible day.

We would also like to add two extra nights at the end of the trip and buy travel insurance for both of us. Could you please send me a total price that includes these items? Finally, my wife is vegetarian, so please let me know whether the hotel can accommodate her meal requests.

Thank you,
Dominic Hollis

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the advertisement?
questions.question_zh: 這則廣告的目的為何?
options: To announce the opening of a new travel office
To promote vacation packages with a discount for booking early
To recruit tour guides for the winter season
To explain a change in airline schedules
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告提供兩個秋季旅遊套裝行程，並說明10月31日前預訂可折扣$150，目的是促銷並鼓勵提早預訂，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What is NOT included in the package price?
questions.question_zh: 套裝行程價格中「不包含」下列何者?
questions.explanation_zh: 第一段說明套裝行程包含機票、飯店、每日早餐與機場接送，第三段指出旅遊保險是選擇性加購，每人$60，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: Why did Mr. Hollis write the e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 霍利斯先生為什麼寫這封電子郵件?
options: To request a price quote for a customized trip
questions.explanation_zh: 電子郵件中他表示想參加托斯卡尼行程，並要求加住兩晚、加購保險，請對方提供含這些項目的總價，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: The word "accommodate" in the e-mail is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 電子郵件中的 "accommodate" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "accommodate her meal requests" 指飯店是否能滿足她的餐飲需求，與 "satisfy" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: If the Hollises book before the deadline, how much will they pay in total?
questions.question_zh: 如果霍利斯夫婦在截止日前預訂，總共要付多少錢?
questions.explanation_zh: 托斯卡尼行程每人$1,890，兩人為$3,780；加住兩晚（一間房）$95×2＝$190；兩人旅遊保險$60×2＝$120；扣除每筆預訂$150折扣，合計$3,940，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What can be inferred about the Hollises' requested departure date?
questions.question_zh: 關於霍利斯夫婦希望的出發日期，可以推論出什麼?
options: It is after the booking deadline
It is during the most expensive season
It is earlier than the first available departure
It is within the scheduled departure period
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告指出所有出發日在11月15日至12月12日之間，而霍利斯先生希望11月20日出發，落在此期間內，因此答案是 (D)。

passages.title: Notice: Scheduled Network Upgrade – Penhallow & Reyes Accounting
paragraphs: To improve the speed and security of our systems, the IT department will upgrade the firm's network on Saturday, November 8. From 10:00 p.m. on Saturday until approximately 6:00 a.m. on Sunday, November 9, e-mail, the shared drive, and remote access will be unavailable. Office telephones will not be affected.

Employees who expect to work over the weekend should save all files locally and log off by 9:30 p.m. on Saturday. Anyone with an urgent client deadline that cannot wait should contact the IT help desk at extension 204 by Wednesday, November 5, so that temporary access to a backup server can be arranged.

All employees will be required to reset their passwords when they first log in on Monday, November 10. A temporary code will be sent to each person's mobile phone, and new passwords must contain at least twelve characters. We appreciate your understanding.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the notice?
questions.question_zh: 這份公告的目的為何?
options: To announce a temporary network outage
To ask employees to change passwords immediately
questions.explanation_zh: 公告開頭說明 IT 部門將於11月8日升級網路，並說明電子郵件、共用硬碟與遠端存取在特定時段將無法使用，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: What will employees need to do on Monday, November 10?
questions.question_zh: 11月10日星期一，員工需要做什麼?
options: Return their laptops to the IT department
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到所有員工在11月10日首次登入時，必須重設密碼，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What should employees with an urgent client deadline do?
questions.question_zh: 有緊急客戶期限的員工應該怎麼做?
options: Work in the office on Saturday night
Contact the IT help desk by November 5
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段提到有緊急客戶期限的員工，須在11月5日前聯絡 IT 服務台，以安排備援伺服器的臨時存取，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "arranged" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "arranged" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "temporary access ... can be arranged" 指臨時存取權限可以被「安排、設定」，與 "set up" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (D)。

passages.title: Corvane Logistics – Travel Expense Report
paragraphs: This form itemizes the business travel expenses of Renata Ostrander for a client workshop in Denver and is submitted to Corvane Logistics for reimbursement.

Expenses: Round-trip airfare, $342.60 (receipt attached). Hotel, three nights at $128.00 per night, $384.00 (receipt attached). Meals, flat per diem of $45.00 for each of four travel days, $180.00 (no receipts required). Airport taxi, $46.40 (receipt attached).

Policy reminder: Receipts must accompany any individual expense over $25.00, except for per diem meals. Claims must be submitted within 14 days of the traveler's return. Approved claims are deposited into the employee's bank account within ten business days.
Ms. Ostrander returned from the trip on September 25 and submitted this form on October 6. Approved by Dwight Calloway, Finance Manager.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this form?
questions.question_zh: 這份表單的目的為何?
options: To request reimbursement for business travel costs
To book a flight and hotel
To apply for a company credit card
questions.explanation_zh: 表單開頭說明這是彙整 Ostrander 女士前往丹佛參加客戶工作坊的差旅費用，並提交公司申請核銷，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: What is the total amount of the expenses listed?
questions.question_zh: 表單所列費用的總額是多少?
questions.explanation_zh: 機票342.60美元、住宿384美元、餐費180美元、機場計程車46.40美元，加總為953美元，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: For which expense is a receipt NOT required?
questions.question_zh: 下列哪一項費用不需要提供收據?
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段規定單筆超過25美元需附收據，但每日固定津貼的餐費除外，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What is indicated about Ms. Ostrander's submission?
questions.question_zh: 關於 Ostrander 女士提交的申請，文中暗示了什麼?
options: It was rejected by the finance manager.
It was submitted after the deadline.
It was submitted within the allowed time.
questions.explanation_zh: 她於9月25日返回、10月6日提交，相隔11天，未超過規定的14天期限，因此答案是 (D)。

passages.title: E-mail: Change to Your November 5 Group Visit
paragraphs: Dear Mr. Fontaine,

Thank you for booking a guided visit for 36 students from Willowbrook Academy on Thursday, November 5. I am writing to let you know about a change to the museum's gallery layout. The East Wing, which houses our collection of nineteenth-century landscape paintings, will be closed from November 2 through November 13 while its lighting system is replaced. Your tour will therefore be moved to the Garden Pavilion, where our new exhibition of modern ceramics is on display.

Your group will still be led by one of our volunteer guides, and the tour will start at 10:00 A.M. as originally planned. Because the pavilion is smaller than the East Wing, we can accommodate no more than 30 visitors at one time. We suggest dividing the students into two groups of 18, with the second group beginning at 10:45 A.M. while the first group takes part in a hands-on clay workshop in the education studio. Admission remains $6 per student, and teachers enter free of charge.
If this arrangement does not suit your class, we would be happy to reschedule your visit for any weekday after November 16. Please reply by October 20 to let me know which option you prefer.

Sincerely,
Priya Nandakumar
Education Coordinator, Orchard Hill Art Museum

questions.question_en: Why did Ms. Nandakumar write to Mr. Fontaine?
questions.question_zh: 為什麼南達庫瑪女士要寫信給方丹先生?
options: To ask for payment for a school tour
To explain a change to a planned visit
To announce a new ceramics exhibition
To invite teachers to a clay workshop
questions.explanation_zh: 信中說明東廂將關閉，因此學生的參觀行程改到花園展館，目的是告知預定參訪的變動。其他選項並非寫信的主要目的，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Why will the East Wing be closed?
questions.question_zh: 東廂為什麼會關閉?
options: Its lighting system will be replaced
Its paintings will be sent to another museum
A workshop will be held there
It is too small for large groups
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段提到東廂將關閉，期間會更換照明系統（while its lighting system is replaced），因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: What is NOT mentioned in the e-mail about the proposed arrangement?
questions.question_zh: 關於信中建議的安排，下列何者「未」被提及?
options: The tour will begin at 10:00 A.M.
The students may be divided into two groups
Students may take part in a clay workshop
Lunch will be provided for the students
questions.explanation_zh: 信中提到導覽仍從上午10點開始、學生分成兩組、另一組參加黏土工作坊，但完全沒有提到供應午餐，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: The word "accommodate" in the e-mail is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 電子郵件中的 "accommodate" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "accommodate no more than 30 visitors" 指展館「最多容納」30位訪客，與 "hold" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (C)。

passages.title: BrightRoof Solar – Fall Installation Special
paragraphs: Make this the year your roof pays you back.

BrightRoof Solar has been designing and installing residential solar systems in the Redfield Valley for twelve years. This fall, homeowners who sign an installation contract before November 30 will receive a free battery storage unit, a $1,800 value, with any system of six kilowatts or larger. Customers who choose a smaller system will receive a free smart energy monitor instead.

Our process is simple. A certified designer visits your home at no charge, measures your roof, and reviews twelve months of your electricity bills. Within one week, you receive a written proposal showing the system size, total cost, and estimated yearly savings. Most installations are finished in two days, and all panels come with a 25-year performance guarantee.
Not ready to buy? Ask about our zero-down leasing plan, which lets you begin saving on day one with a fixed monthly payment. Please note that the free battery offer cannot be combined with leasing.
To book your free home assessment, call 555-0148 or visit www.brightroofsolar.example. Appointments are limited to 15 per week, so reserve yours today.

questions.question_en: What is the main purpose of the advertisement?
questions.question_zh: 這則廣告的主要目的為何?
options: To explain how to read an electricity bill
To promote a limited-time offer on home solar systems
To announce the opening of a new branch
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告介紹秋季簽約即贈送電池儲能裝置或能源監測器的優惠，是在推廣限時的住宅太陽能系統方案，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What is included in the free home assessment?
questions.question_zh: 免費的住家評估包含什麼?
options: A review of the customer's electricity bills
The installation of a smart energy monitor
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段說明設計師會免費到府、測量屋頂，並檢視客戶十二個月的電費單，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: Which customer would receive the free battery storage unit?
questions.question_zh: 下列哪一位客戶會獲得免費的電池儲能裝置?
options: A customer who signs on November 10 for a four-kilowatt system
A customer who signs on December 2 for an eight-kilowatt system
A customer who chooses the leasing plan on November 15 for a seven-kilowatt system
A customer who signs on November 28 for a six-kilowatt system
questions.explanation_zh: 須在11月30日前簽約且系統達6千瓦以上才有免費電池。(A) 系統太小，只能拿到監測器；(B) 12月2日已超過期限；(C) 選擇租賃方案，不能與電池優惠併用；只有 (D) 符合所有條件，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: What can be inferred about BrightRoof Solar?
questions.question_zh: 關於 BrightRoof Solar，可以推論出什麼?
options: It manufactures the panels it installs
It can conduct only a limited number of home assessments each week
It has operated for less than a year
It requires customers to pay a fee for proposals
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告末段說每週預約名額限15個，可推知公司每週能進行的到府評估數量有限。公司已營運十二年、評估與提案皆未提及收費，也沒說自行製造面板，因此答案是 (B)。

passages.title: Notice to Members: Online Banking Maintenance and Eastgate Branch Hours
paragraphs: Larkspur Credit Union will perform scheduled maintenance on its online and mobile banking systems on Saturday, October 31, from 11:00 P.M. until 5:00 A.M. on Sunday, November 1. During this time, members will not be able to log in, transfer funds, or deposit checks by mobile app. Debit cards and ATMs will continue to work normally, and our telephone service line, 555-0192, will remain open until 8:00 P.M. on Saturday.

The upgrade will introduce a new security feature that requires members to confirm large transfers of $2,000 or more through a one-time code sent to their registered phone. Members who have changed their phone number recently are encouraged to update it at any branch or by calling the service line before October 31. Those who do not update their number may be unable to complete large transfers until their information is verified.

In addition, beginning Monday, November 2, the Eastgate branch will open at 8:30 A.M. instead of 9:00 A.M. on weekdays. The Main Street branch hours will not change. We apologize for any inconvenience and thank you for banking with Larkspur Credit Union.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the notice?
questions.question_zh: 這則通知的目的為何?
options: To invite members to open new accounts
To announce an increase in service fees
To advertise a mobile banking application
To inform members of system maintenance and a schedule change
questions.explanation_zh: 通知說明線上與行動銀行的定期維護，以及東門分行營業時間的調整，目的是告知會員這些變動，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: What will members still be able to do during the maintenance period?
questions.question_zh: 維護期間，會員仍然可以做什麼?
options: Deposit checks through the mobile app
questions.explanation_zh: 第一段說明維護期間無法登入、轉帳或以手機存支票，但簽帳金融卡與提款機仍正常運作，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Who is encouraged to contact the credit union before October 31?
questions.question_zh: 哪些人被鼓勵在10月31日前聯絡信用合作社?
options: Members whose phone numbers have changed
Members who live near the Eastgate branch
Members who plan to deposit checks
Members who use the telephone service line
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段指出最近更換電話號碼的會員，應在10月31日前更新資料，否則可能無法完成大額轉帳，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: What is indicated about the Eastgate branch?
questions.question_zh: 關於東門分行，通知中提到什麼?
options: It will close earlier on weekdays
It will be closed on November 2
It will open 30 minutes earlier on weekdays
It will replace the Main Street branch
questions.explanation_zh: 自11月2日起，東門分行平日開門時間由上午9:00改為8:30，也就是提早30分鐘。關門時間、休業與取代總行均未提及，因此答案是 (C)。

passages.title: Ridgeway Builders – Purchase Requisition Form
paragraphs: Item requested: Ruggedized tablet computers for use by site inspectors at the Harbor View Apartments project. Quantity: 6. Unit price: $480.00. Subtotal: $2,880.00.
Additional items: Protective cases ($25.00 each) and a one-year extended warranty ($60.00 per tablet). Total estimated cost: $3,390.00.

Justification: Inspectors currently record safety checks on paper forms, which must be retyped in the office. This causes delays of up to two days in reporting problems. Tablets would allow inspections to be entered and submitted on site. Requested delivery date: October 27, before the structural phase begins on November 3.
Approval: The department manager's signature is required for purchases over $2,500. Purchases over $5,000 also require the signature of the finance director.

passages.title: E-mail: Reply to Requisition PR-3382
paragraphs: Dear Tobias,

Your department manager has approved requisition PR-3382, and I have reviewed it against our current supplier agreements. Our preferred vendor, Norvik Systems, is offering the same tablets at $450.00 each for orders of eight or more units, and the extended warranty is included free at that quantity. The protective cases remain $25.00 each.

Orders of eight or more units ship from the vendor's regional warehouse and typically arrive within five business days. An order for six units must be shipped from overseas and would take about three weeks.
Would you consider ordering eight tablets instead of six? The two extra units could serve as spares for the inspectors. Please let me know by Friday, and I will place the order right away.

questions.question_en: Why did Mr. Lindqvist submit the form?
questions.question_zh: 林德奎斯特先生為什麼要提交這份表單?
options: To request the purchase of tablet computers
To report a safety problem at a construction site
To apply for an extended warranty
To order protective cases for a subcontractor
questions.explanation_zh: 表單第一項即列出要採購供工地檢查員使用的堅固型平板電腦，因此這份表單是採購申請，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the form, what problem does the purchase aim to solve?
questions.question_zh: 根據表單，這項採購想要解決什麼問題?
options: Tablets are too expensive to repair
The project has run out of budget
questions.explanation_zh: 理由欄說明檢查員目前用紙本記錄，回辦公室重打，造成最多兩天的通報延誤，平板可在現場直接輸入，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Who most likely signed the requisition before it reached Ms. Dubois?
questions.question_zh: 在採購單送到杜波依女士手上之前，最可能是誰簽名核准?
questions.explanation_zh: 總預估金額 $3,390 超過 $2,500，需部門經理簽名，但未超過 $5,000，所以不需財務長簽核；電子郵件也說明部門經理已核准，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: What does Ms. Dubois suggest in the e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 杜波依女士在電子郵件中提出什麼建議?
options: Increasing the order from six tablets to eight
questions.explanation_zh: 她詢問林德奎斯特是否願意把訂購數量由六台增加為八台，以取得較低單價與免費延長保固，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: How much would the total cost be if Mr. Lindqvist accepts Ms. Dubois's suggestion?
questions.question_zh: 如果林德奎斯特先生接受杜波依女士的建議，總費用會是多少?

questions.question_en: Why might keeping the order at six tablets be a problem?
questions.question_zh: 為什麼維持訂購六台平板可能會有問題?
options: They might not arrive by the requested delivery date
They would cost more than the approval limit
They would not be covered by any warranty
They would not work with the inspection forms
questions.explanation_zh: 六台的訂單要從海外出貨，約需三週；從10月13日起算約在11月3日才到，晚於表單上要求的10月27日交貨日，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Kestrel Motors – Certified Pre-Owned Weekend
paragraphs: Drive Home Confidence This Weekend

Kestrel Motors invites you to our Certified Pre-Owned Weekend, Friday, November 6, through Sunday, November 8, at 1450 Lakeshore Boulevard. Choose from more than 80 sedans, SUVs, and trucks, each under six years old and each with fewer than 60,000 miles.

Every certified vehicle passes a 150-point inspection by our factory-trained technicians and comes with a 12-month warranty and one year of free roadside assistance. A complete vehicle history report is available for every car on the lot.

Special offers for the weekend: Receive $500 off the purchase price of any vehicle when you present this advertisement at the sales desk. Qualified buyers can take advantage of financing as low as 2.9 percent APR for up to 48 months. Planning to trade in your current car? Our appraisal team will give you a written offer in about 20 minutes, even if you do not buy from us.

Showroom hours: Friday, 10:00 A.M. to 8:00 P.M.; Saturday, 9:00 A.M. to 6:00 P.M.; Sunday, 12:00 noon to 5:00 P.M. Test drives require a valid driver's license. Visit www.kestrelmotors.example for the full inventory list.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the advertisement?
questions.question_zh: 這則廣告的目的為何?
options: To promote a weekend sales event for used vehicles
To announce the opening of a second showroom
To explain a new vehicle warranty law
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告宣傳週末的認證中古車特賣活動，並列出優惠與營業時間，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What must customers do to receive $500 off?
questions.question_zh: 顧客必須做什麼才能獲得 $500 折扣?
options: Present the advertisement at the sales desk
questions.explanation_zh: 第四段說明在銷售櫃檯出示這則廣告，購買任何車輛即可折抵 $500；並未要求以舊換新、貸款或特定日期，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What is suggested about the trade-in appraisal?
questions.question_zh: 關於舊車估價，廣告暗示了什麼?
options: Customers can receive an offer without buying a vehicle
It is available only on Sunday
It is free only for certified vehicles
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告說估價團隊約20分鐘內提供書面報價，「即使您不在我們這裡買車」也可以，可推知不購車也能取得報價，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: What is NOT mentioned as a benefit of buying a certified vehicle?
questions.question_zh: 下列何者「未」被提及為購買認證車的好處?
options: Free roadside assistance for one year
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到150項檢驗、12個月保固與一年免費道路救援，但並未提供免費替代車，因此答案是 (D)。

passages.title: Notice to Residents: Holiday Week Waste Collection in Dunmore
paragraphs: The Dunmore Public Works Department announces changes to curbside collection during the Thanksgiving holiday week. There will be no collection on Thursday, November 26. Households with regular Thursday pickup will have their trash and recycling collected on Friday, November 27, and households with regular Friday pickup will be served on Saturday, November 28. Monday through Wednesday routes are not affected.

Please place bins at the curb by 6:30 A.M. on your collection day. Because of expected heavy volume after the holiday, bins that are overfilled or have lids that do not close may not be emptied. Extra bags will not be collected unless they carry a Dunmore Overflow Sticker, available for $2.00 each at City Hall and the Eastside Recreation Center.

Seasonal yard waste collection ends for the year after Friday, November 20. Residents with leaves left over may bring them to the Millbrook Transfer Station, open Saturdays from 8:00 A.M. to 3:00 P.M. Use of the station is free for Dunmore residents who show proof of address. Please note that the department's customer service line, 555-0173, will be closed on November 26 and 27 and will reopen on Monday, November 30.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the notice?
questions.question_zh: 這則通知的目的為何?
options: To announce a new recycling program
To request volunteers for a cleanup day
To inform residents of schedule changes during a holiday week
To raise the price of trash collection
questions.explanation_zh: 通知說明感恩節當週路邊垃圾收運的日期調整與相關注意事項，目的是告知居民時程變動，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: Which households will NOT have their collection day changed?
questions.question_zh: 哪些住戶的收運日「不會」改變?
options: Households that live near City Hall
questions.explanation_zh: 第一段說週一至週三的路線不受影響，因此週二收運的住戶不變；週四、週五路線則分別順延一天，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: What is required for extra bags to be collected?
questions.question_zh: 額外的垃圾袋要被收走，必須符合什麼條件?
options: They must be placed at the curb after 6:30 A.M.
They must carry an overflow sticker
They must be taken to City Hall
They must contain only recyclable materials
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段指出額外的袋子必須貼有 Dunmore Overflow Sticker 才會被收運，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What is indicated about the Millbrook Transfer Station?
questions.question_zh: 關於 Millbrook 轉運站，通知中提到什麼?
options: Residents must show proof of address to use it for free
It is open every day of the week
It charges a $2.00 fee for leaves
It is located next to City Hall
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段說該站週六開放，且鎮上居民出示住址證明即可免費使用。其他選項皆與內容不符，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Tamarind Biolabs – Overtime Request Form
paragraphs: Overtime requested: Saturday, October 24, from 8:00 A.M. to 2:00 P.M. (6 hours) and Saturday, October 31, from 8:00 A.M. to 2:00 P.M. (6 hours).

Reason for request: The laboratory has been commissioned to prepare 240 cell culture plates for a client trial that begins on November 3. Because the incubator cycle cannot be interrupted, the plates must be inspected and relabeled on weekends, when the equipment is not in use by other teams. Without the additional hours, the shipment would be delayed by at least one week.

Compensation: Under company policy, overtime worked on a weekend is paid at 1.5 times the regular hourly rate. Employees may instead choose compensatory time off, which is credited at one hour for every hour worked and must be taken within 60 days.

Approval: Requests must be signed by the supervisor at least 48 hours before the first overtime shift. Overtime totaling more than 10 hours in a month also requires approval from the Director of Operations.

questions.question_en: What is the main reason for the overtime request?
questions.question_zh: 加班申請的主要原因為何?
options: To finish preparing materials for a client trial
questions.explanation_zh: 理由欄說明實驗室受託準備240片細胞培養盤，供11月3日開始的客戶試驗使用，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: Why must the work be done on weekends?
questions.question_zh: 為什麼這項工作必須在週末進行?
options: Weekend pay is lower than weekday pay
The equipment is not being used by other teams then
questions.explanation_zh: 理由欄提到週末設備沒有被其他團隊使用，培養盤才能在不中斷培養週期的情況下檢查與重貼標籤，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: Why does the request require approval from the Director of Operations?
questions.question_zh: 為什麼這份申請需要營運總監的核准?
options: It was submitted less than 48 hours in advance
The requested hours total more than 10 in October
The employee prefers time off instead of pay
questions.explanation_zh: 兩次加班各6小時，10月合計12小時，超過每月10小時的上限，因此需營運總監核准。10月20日提交距10月24日已超過48小時，故 (A) 不對，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: How many hours of time off would Mr. Raghavan earn if he chose compensatory time for the entire request?
questions.question_zh: 如果拉加文先生對整份申請選擇補休，他可獲得多少小時的補休?
questions.explanation_zh: 補休是工作一小時換一小時，共加班12小時，所以補休12小時。18小時是把12小時乘以1.5倍加班費率的錯誤算法，因此答案是 (B)。

passages.title: E-mail: Changes to Your Weekly Lobby Arrangement

meta.label: Subject:
meta.value: Changes to your weekly lobby arrangement

paragraphs: Dear Mr. Lindqvist,
Thank you for being a Petalwick Florals subscriber since June. Your Monday lobby arrangement has become one of our most admired weekly designs, and we are glad to keep supplying it.

I am writing to let you know that, beginning November 2, the price of our standard weekly arrangement will rise from $48 to $54 per delivery. The increase reflects higher shipping costs for imported flowers, and it applies to all subscription customers.

However, we would like to offer you an alternative. Our seasonal Autumn Harvest arrangement, made with sunflowers, dried wheat, and orange roses, will remain $48 per delivery through November 27. After that date, it will be priced at the new standard rate of $54. To reserve this option, please reply to this e-mail by October 28.
You are also welcome to keep your current arrangement at the new price. In that case, no action is needed.

Warm regards,
Imogen Frost
Customer Accounts, Petalwick Florals

passages.title: E-mail: Reply Regarding Lobby Arrangement and Open House

meta.label: Subject:
meta.value: RE: Changes to your weekly lobby arrangement

paragraphs: Dear Ms. Frost,
Thank you for the advance notice. We would like to switch to the Autumn Harvest arrangement at $48 per delivery, so please consider this e-mail our confirmation.

I have a few additional requests. First, our weekly staff meeting is held on Monday mornings, and deliveries on that day have disrupted the lobby. Could future deliveries be made on Wednesday mornings before 9:00? Second, Corvin Design Studio will hold a client open house on November 13, and we would like a quote for twelve small table arrangements in similar autumn colors. They would need to be delivered by noon that day.
Finally, please send all invoices to our accounting team at accounts@corvindesign.com rather than to me directly.

Best regards,
Tobias Lindqvist
Office Manager, Corvin Design Studio

questions.question_en: Why did Ms. Frost write to Mr. Lindqvist?
questions.question_zh: 為什麼 Frost 女士要寫信給 Lindqvist 先生?
options: To apologize for a late delivery
To announce a price increase and suggest an alternative
To request payment for an overdue invoice
To ask him to renew his subscription for a full year
questions.explanation_zh: 第一封信說明11月2日起標準每週花藝的價格將由48美元調漲至54美元，並提供價格不變的秋季豐收款作為替代選擇，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: By what date must customers reply to reserve the Autumn Harvest arrangement?
questions.question_zh: 客戶必須在哪一天之前回覆，才能保留秋季豐收款花藝?
questions.explanation_zh: 第一封信寫道請於10月28日前回覆以保留此選項；11月2日是漲價生效日，11月27日是優惠價截止日，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: The word "reserve" in the first e-mail is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第一封電子郵件中的 "reserve" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "reserve this option" 指「保留、確保這個選項」，與 "secure" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: What does Mr. Lindqvist NOT ask Petalwick Florals to do?
questions.question_zh: Lindqvist 先生沒有要求 Petalwick Florals 做下列何事?
options: Provide a quote for table arrangements
Send invoices to the accounting team
questions.explanation_zh: 第二封信中他要求改為週三送花、為開放日報價12盆桌花、並將發票寄給會計部門，但他選擇了秋季豐收款而非取消訂閱，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: How much will Corvin Design Studio most likely pay per delivery during the week of November 9?
questions.question_zh: 11月9日當週，Corvin Design Studio 每次送花最可能支付多少錢?
questions.explanation_zh: Lindqvist 先生在回信中選擇秋季豐收款，每次48美元，而第一封信說明此價格持續到11月27日，因此11月9日當週仍為48美元，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will most likely happen after November 27?
questions.question_zh: 11月27日之後最可能發生什麼事?
options: The Autumn Harvest promotion will begin
Corvin's subscription will be canceled automatically
The weekly price of Corvin's arrangement will rise to $54
Petalwick will deliver twelve table arrangements
questions.explanation_zh: 第一封信指出秋季豐收款的48美元價格只到11月27日，之後將改為新的標準價54美元，而Corvin已選擇該款式，所以每週價格會升為54美元；桌花是11月13日的活動需求，與11月27日之後無關，因此答案是 (C)。

passages.title: Notice: Galaxy Gallery Renovation at Halden Science Museum
paragraphs: Halden Science Museum will close its second-floor Galaxy Gallery for renovation from Monday, November 9, through Friday, December 18. All other areas of the museum, including the cafe and the gift shop, will remain open during regular hours.

To make up for the temporary closure, adult admission will be reduced from $18 to $13 for the duration of the renovation. Children under 12 will continue to enter free when accompanied by an adult. Annual members will not be charged for any part of the closure, and their passes will be extended automatically at no cost.

Visitors who bought tickets specifically for the Galaxy Gallery may exchange them for a pass to the Dome Theater's "Journey to Saturn" show or request a refund at the front desk until December 31. Please bring your original receipt. The planetarium will also present additional showings at 4:00 P.M. on weekends throughout the renovation.
We apologize for any inconvenience. We look forward to unveiling the new gallery, which will feature an interactive Mars rover display, on Saturday, December 19.

questions.question_en: What is the notice mainly about?
questions.question_zh: 這則公告主要是關於什麼?
options: The opening of a new cafe
The temporary closure of a gallery
A new schedule for school tours
questions.explanation_zh: 公告第一段說明二樓 Galaxy Gallery 將因整修而暫時關閉，整則公告都圍繞這件事，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: Why is the museum most likely lowering its adult admission price?
questions.question_zh: 博物館降低成人票價最可能的原因為何?
options: To compensate visitors for the closed gallery
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段開頭的 "To make up for the temporary closure" 顯示降價是為了補償訪客無法參觀展廳，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What is NOT true about the museum during the renovation?
questions.question_zh: 關於整修期間的博物館，下列何者「不」正確?
options: The cafe will keep its regular hours.
Children under 12 can enter free with an adult.
Extra planetarium showings will be offered on weekends.
Annual members must pay to extend their passes.
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段說年度會員的通行證會自動免費延長，並未要求付費，其他選項在文中都有提到，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: The word "unveiling" in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第四段中的 "unveiling" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "unveiling the new gallery" 指新展廳首度揭幕公開，與 revealing 最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Warranty Claim Form: Alderwood Furniture
paragraphs: Customer Information: Priya Raman, 17 Lakeview Terrace, Denton. Product: Hartley extendable dining table, model HT-240, purchased with a total payment of $1,260, which includes $60 for delivery.

Description of problem: One of the table's two extension leaves no longer fits flush with the main surface. A gap of about five millimeters has appeared along the seam, and the wood in the leaf appears to be bending upward. The table has always been kept in a climate-controlled dining room and has not been exposed to water or direct sunlight.
Preferred resolution: Replacement of the extension leaf. (Other options on this form: repair or full refund.)
Attachments: three photographs of the damaged leaf and a copy of the original receipt.
I confirm that the information provided above is accurate. Signature: Priya Raman

passages.title: E-mail: Warranty Claim WC-5207 Approved
paragraphs: Dear Ms. Raman,

Thank you for submitting claim WC-5207 and the photographs of your dining table. After reviewing them, our warranty team has approved your request for a replacement extension leaf. The bending you described is a manufacturing defect, and because the table was purchased in March, it is well within the coverage period for structural parts.

The new leaf will be made at our workshop and should be ready about three weeks from today. Please note that natural wood changes color over time, so the replacement may look slightly lighter than the rest of your table at first. The difference will fade gradually. Once the leaf is ready, our delivery team will call you to arrange a convenient time. Delivery and installation are free of charge.
We apologize for the inconvenience this has caused you. If you have any questions in the meantime, please reply to this message.
Sincerely,
Marcus Bell
Warranty Services, Alderwood Furniture

passages.title: Alderwood Furniture: Warranty Policy
paragraphs: Coverage: Structural parts, including frames, legs, tabletops, and extension mechanisms, are covered against defects in materials and workmanship for five years from the date of purchase. Finishes and upholstery fabrics are covered for one year from the date of purchase.

How to file a claim: Complete the Warranty Claim Form and attach photographs of the damage and a copy of your receipt. Claims are reviewed within seven business days of receipt. Customers may state a preferred resolution, but Alderwood will decide whether to repair, replace, or refund the item.

What is not covered: Damage caused by exposure to moisture, misuse, or repairs made by anyone other than Alderwood is not covered. Slight color variation in natural wood is normal and is not considered a defect.
Approved claims: For approved claims, Alderwood pays all costs for parts, labor, and delivery within its service area. Customers outside the service area pay shipping only.

questions.question_en: What problem does Ms. Raman report on the form?
questions.question_zh: Raman 女士在表單上回報了什麼問題?
options: One of the table's extension leaves is warping.
The finish has faded in the sunlight.
questions.explanation_zh: 表單的問題描述寫到其中一片延伸板無法與桌面齊平，木板向上彎曲變形，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: How much did Ms. Raman pay for the table itself, not including delivery?
questions.question_zh: Raman 女士購買桌子本身(不含運費)花了多少錢?
questions.explanation_zh: 表單寫明總付款為 $1,260，其中運費為 $60，所以桌子本身是 1,260 減 60 等於 $1,200。選項 (C) 是含運費的總額，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Why was Ms. Raman's claim approved?
questions.question_zh: Raman 女士的申請為何獲得核准?
options: Moisture damage is covered by the policy.
The problem was judged to be a manufacturing defect.
questions.explanation_zh: 電子郵件說明她描述的彎曲屬於製造瑕疵，且購買時間仍在結構零件的保固期內，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: When will the replacement leaf most likely be ready?
questions.question_zh: 更換用的延伸板最可能在何時完成?
questions.explanation_zh: 電子郵件日期是 10 月 16 日，信中說約三週後完成，10 月 16 日加三週是 11 月 6 日，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: Until when are the structural parts of Ms. Raman's table covered by the warranty?
questions.question_zh: Raman 女士桌子的結構零件保固到何時為止?
questions.explanation_zh: 表單顯示購買日是 2026 年 3 月 14 日，保固政策說結構零件保固五年，所以到 2031 年 3 月 14 日，需合併表單與政策才能得出，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: According to the warranty policy, which of the following would NOT be covered?
questions.question_zh: 根據保固政策，下列何者「不」在保固範圍內?
options: A shelf that swells after being kept in a flooded basement
A chair frame that cracks in the fourth year because of a defect
A table leg that splits in the second year because of a flaw in the wood
An extension mechanism that jams in the third year because of faulty workmanship
questions.explanation_zh: 政策明載因接觸水氣造成的損壞不在保固範圍內，其他三項都是結構零件在五年內因瑕疵或工藝問題而損壞，屬於保固範圍，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: What can be inferred about a slight color difference in the replacement leaf?
questions.question_zh: 關於更換延伸板可能出現的輕微色差，可以推論出什麼?
options: It would entitle Ms. Raman to a full refund.
Alderwood would not consider it a defect.
It was caused by moisture damage.
questions.explanation_zh: 電子郵件指出新板的顏色起初可能略淡，之後會逐漸消退，而政策說明天然木材的輕微色差屬正常、不視為瑕疵，因此公司不會把它當成瑕疵，因此答案是 (B)。

passages.title: Letter: Renewal of Your Business Insurance Policy

meta.label: Re:
meta.value: Renewal of Your Business Insurance Policy

paragraphs: Dear Mr. Beltran,

Your business insurance policy with Cardinal Shield Insurance is due to expire on December 31. We are writing to let you know that we would be glad to renew it for another year. When we reviewed your account, we noticed that you added a delivery van to your business in June. We have updated your coverage to include the vehicle, and this is the main reason for a change in your premium.

The renewal premium is $2,520, which is 5 percent higher than this year's premium of $2,400. You may pay in four quarterly installments of $630 each. Alternatively, if you pay the full amount by November 30, you will receive a 10 percent discount on the renewal premium.

To avoid any gap in your coverage, please sign and return the enclosed renewal confirmation form by November 15. If you would like to adjust the amount of coverage, contact your agent, Lena Hoffmann, at 555-0119 before that date.
We appreciate your continued trust in Cardinal Shield and look forward to serving Beltran Flowers in the coming year.
Sincerely,
Warren Pike
Customer Accounts, Cardinal Shield Insurance

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the letter?
questions.question_zh: 這封信的目的為何?
options: To announce a new insurance product
To request payment for a late premium
To inform a customer about renewing an insurance policy
questions.explanation_zh: 信中說明保單即將到期，並提供續約保費、付款方式與回覆期限，目的是通知客戶續約事宜，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: How much will Mr. Beltran pay if he takes the discount?
questions.question_zh: 如果 Beltran 先生選擇享有折扣，他要付多少錢?
questions.explanation_zh: 續約保費是 $2,520，十一月三十日前全額付清可打九折，2,520 乘以 0.9 等於 $2,268，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What is Mr. Beltran asked to do by November 15?
questions.question_zh: Beltran 先生被要求在 11 月 15 日前做什麼?
options: Call the agent to cancel the policy
Return a signed renewal confirmation form
questions.explanation_zh: 信中要求在 11 月 15 日前簽署並寄回續約確認表。全額付款的期限是 11 月 30 日，不是 11 月 15 日，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What can be inferred about Beltran Flowers?
questions.question_zh: 關於 Beltran Flowers，可以推論出什麼?
options: It expanded its operations this year.
It filed several claims this year.
It plans to move to a new location.
questions.explanation_zh: 信中提到該公司六月新增了一輛送貨車，並因此調整保障，可推論公司今年擴大了營運，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Pixelhaven Electronics: Trade-In Week
paragraphs: Pixelhaven Electronics Trade-In Week, November 2 to November 8

Is your old phone sitting in a drawer? Bring it to Pixelhaven Electronics from Monday, November 2, through Sunday, November 8, and turn it into store credit toward something new. We accept working smartphones, tablets, and laptops of any brand.

Trade-in values: smartphones up to $200, tablets up to $120, and laptops up to $350. The final value depends on the device's condition, which our technicians will check on the spot in about ten minutes. Bring the original box and charger and receive a 10 percent bonus on top of the quoted value.
Please back up your data before you come in. Our staff will erase all personal information from every device. A valid photo ID is required for all trade-ins.

Store credit can be used on any new item in our store and remains valid until January 31, but it cannot be exchanged for cash. The first 40 customers each day will also receive a free phone case. Visit us at 220 Harbor Avenue, open 10:00 A.M. to 8:00 P.M. Monday through Saturday, and 11:00 A.M. to 6:00 P.M. on Sunday.

questions.question_en: What is being advertised?
questions.question_zh: 這則廣告在宣傳什麼?
options: A repair service for broken phones
A program for exchanging used devices for store credit
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告說明顧客可把舊的手機、平板與筆電換成店內抵用金，這是一項以舊換新的活動，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What are customers advised to do before they come to the store?
questions.question_zh: 廣告建議顧客在到店前先做什麼?
options: Register on the store's Web site
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段請顧客在到店前先備份資料，個資會由店員清除，不需要自己清除，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: A customer trades in a tablet valued at $100 and brings the original box. How much store credit will the customer receive?
questions.question_zh: 一位顧客以估價 $100 的平板舊換新，且帶了原廠包裝盒。顧客可獲得多少抵用金?
questions.explanation_zh: 帶原廠盒與充電器可在估價之上多得 10% 加成，100 加上 10 等於 $110，且未超過平板上限 $120，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Which of the following is true about the store credit?
questions.question_zh: 關於店內抵用金，下列何者正確?
options: It can be exchanged for cash.
It is valid only for phone purchases.
It can be used for any new item in the store.
questions.explanation_zh: 最後一段說明抵用金可用於店內任何新品，有效期至 1 月 31 日，且不能換成現金，因此答案是 (D)。

passages.title: Volunteer Shift Registration Form: Eastgate Community Food Bank
paragraphs: Activities our group would like to take part in (Yes or No): Sorting donated food, Yes. Packing family boxes, Yes. Loading delivery trucks, No.
Special notes: Two members of our group are 17 years old. Please let us know whether they are allowed to volunteer and what is required.

paragraphs: Dear Ms. Fischer,

However, we still have room for 15 volunteers in the afternoon shift, which runs from 1:00 P.M. to 4:00 P.M. on the same day. I hope that this works for your group.

Carlos Medina

questions.question_en: In which activities does Ms. Fischer's group want to take part?
