questions.explanation_zh: 表單中分類食物與包裝家庭箱勾選 Yes，裝載送貨卡車勾選 No，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: What does Ms. Fischer ask about in the special notes?
questions.question_zh: Fischer 女士在特別備註中詢問什麼?
options: Whether the shift can be shortened
questions.explanation_zh: 備註寫到團體中有兩位十七歲成員，詢問他們能否參與以及需要什麼條件，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: Why can the group NOT take the morning shift?
questions.question_zh: 為什麼這個團體無法參加早上的班次?
options: It is only for experienced volunteers.
questions.explanation_zh: 電子郵件第二段說明十一月十四日早班已經額滿，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: By what time should the group arrive on November 14?
questions.question_zh: 團體在 11 月 14 日應該在何時之前抵達?
questions.explanation_zh: 原本申請的早班已額滿，改為下午 1 點開始的班次，並要求在 12:45 P.M. 前抵達參加安全說明，需結合兩份文件判斷，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What must be provided for the two 17-year-olds?
questions.question_zh: 兩位十七歲成員需要提供什麼?
options: A permission form signed by a parent or guardian
questions.explanation_zh: 電子郵件說明 16 到 17 歲的志工須繳交家長或監護人簽名的同意書，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: How many places will remain in the afternoon shift if Ms. Fischer's group joins?
questions.question_zh: 如果 Fischer 女士的團體加入，下午班次還會剩下幾個名額?
questions.explanation_zh: 電子郵件說下午班次還有 15 個名額，表單顯示團體有 12 人，所以剩下 15 減 12 等於 3 個名額，因此答案是 (C)。

passages.title: E-mail: Revised Courtyard Plan for Hartwell Community Center
paragraphs: Dear Mr. Okonkwo,

Thank you for meeting with us on October 21. As promised, I am attaching the revised site plan for the Hartwell Community Center courtyard. Based on your feedback, we made three changes. First, we replaced the large lawn with drought-resistant ground cover, which will significantly reduce water use. Second, we increased the number of benches from four to six. Third, we moved the fountain to the east side of the courtyard so that it is visible from the main lobby.
These changes raise the cost estimate from $34,000 to $37,400. We believe the additional investment will pay off through lower maintenance and watering costs over time.

If the board approves the budget at its November 12 meeting, we can begin construction on Monday, March 1, and expect to complete the work in about six weeks. Because many of the plants must be ordered well in advance, we would appreciate hearing the board's decision as soon as possible.
I am available to meet again on November 3 or 5 if you would like to discuss the plan further.
Best regards,
Elena Marquez
Project Designer, Greenway Landscape Design

questions.question_en: Why did Ms. Marquez write the e-mail?
questions.question_zh: Marquez 女士為什麼寫這封電子郵件?
options: To present a modified design and its cost
To invite Mr. Okonkwo to a board meeting
To ask for payment of an invoice
questions.explanation_zh: 信中附上修改後的場地規劃圖，說明三項更動與新的預估費用，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: Which change was NOT made to the original plan?
questions.question_zh: 下列哪一項「不是」對原規劃所做的更動?
options: The lawn was replaced with ground cover.
The fountain was moved to the east side.
questions.explanation_zh: 信中提到的三項更動是以耐旱地被取代草坪、長椅由四張增加為六張，以及將噴水池移到東側，並沒有縮小中庭，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: How much more will the revised plan cost than the original?
questions.question_zh: 修改後的規劃比原規劃多花多少錢?

questions.question_en: What is suggested about the construction?
questions.question_zh: 關於施工，信中暗示了什麼?
options: It has already received board approval.
It depends on a decision by the board.
It will take about six months.
questions.explanation_zh: 信中說若董事會在 11 月 12 日核准預算才能在 3 月 1 日動工，表示施工取決於董事會的決定，尚未獲得核准，工期約六週而非六個月，因此答案是 (C)。

passages.title: Larkspur Animal Hospital – Pet Wellness Month
paragraphs: Is your pet due for a check-up? Larkspur Animal Hospital is celebrating Pet Wellness Month from November 2 to November 30. During this time, every dog or cat can receive a complete nose-to-tail exam for just $29 (regularly $65). Our veterinarians will check your pet's weight, heart, and teeth, and will review its vaccination record.

Pets aged eight years or older also qualify for a free senior blood panel, an $80 value, when it is scheduled together with the exam. Need vaccines? Our Core Vaccine Package is available for $45 (regularly $60) and can be added to any visit. Please note that Wellness Month offers cannot be combined with other discounts or coupons.

On Wednesday, November 18, at 6:30 p.m., Dr. Amara Singh will lead a free seminar on choosing the right diet for pets of every age. Seating is limited to 30 guests, so please reserve a place at the front desk.

Appointments are required for exams and can be booked at www.larkspurah.com or by calling (555) 014-7782. We are open Monday through Friday from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. and on Saturday from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. The hospital will be closed on Thursday, November 26, for the holiday.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the advertisement?
questions.question_zh: 這則廣告的目的為何?
options: To announce that a new veterinarian has joined the staff
To advertise a pet food sale
To recruit volunteers for an animal shelter
To promote discounted pet health services
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告說明 Larkspur Animal Hospital 在11月的寵物健康月提供優惠的健康檢查與疫苗服務，目的是推廣折扣的寵物健康服務，其餘選項文中均未提到，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: How much can a customer save on a nose-to-tail exam during Pet Wellness Month?
questions.question_zh: 在寵物健康月期間，顧客做一次全面健檢可以省下多少錢?
questions.explanation_zh: 第一段提到全面健檢原價65美元、活動價29美元，65減29等於36美元，因此可省下36美元，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Which pet would most likely receive a free blood panel?
questions.question_zh: 下列哪一隻寵物最可能獲得免費的血液檢查?
options: A 10-year-old cat scheduled for an exam
A 3-year-old dog receiving the Core Vaccine Package only
A puppy whose owner attends the seminar
A 6-year-old dog scheduled for an exam
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段指出8歲(含)以上的寵物在預約健檢時可享免費高齡血液檢查，只有10歲的貓同時符合年齡與預約健檢兩項條件；3歲的狗只打疫苗、小狗和6歲的狗年齡都不到8歲，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: The word "qualify" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "qualify" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "qualify for a free blood panel" 指「有資格」享有免費血液檢查，與 "be eligible" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (C)。

passages.title: Notice: Water Service Shutoff on Harlan Avenue
paragraphs: Riverbend Water Authority will replace a main water pipe along Harlan Avenue between 4th Street and 9th Street. To complete the work safely, water service to all homes and businesses on those blocks will be shut off on Tuesday, November 10, from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.

Customers should store enough water for drinking, cooking, and cleaning before the shutoff begins. When service is restored, water may look cloudy or slightly discolored for a short time. This is not harmful, and running cold water through your faucets for several minutes will usually clear it up.

If heavy rain makes the work unsafe, the shutoff will be moved to Thursday, November 12, during the same hours. Updates will be posted at www.riverbendwater.com and sent by text message to customers who have registered a mobile number. Residents who rely on medical equipment that requires water should call (555) 016-3300 by November 6 to arrange a free delivery of bottled water.

Free bottled water will also be available to all affected customers at Fire Station 3 on Harlan Avenue from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. on the day of the shutoff. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding.

questions.question_en: Why was the notice written?
questions.question_zh: 為什麼要發布這則公告?
options: To announce an increase in water rates
To ask customers to conserve water during a drought
To warn customers of a temporary interruption in service
To explain how to read a water bill
questions.explanation_zh: 公告說明 Harlan Avenue 部分路段將因更換主水管而在11月10日暫停供水，目的是通知客戶暫時停水，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What will happen if the weather is bad on November 10?
questions.question_zh: 如果11月10日天氣不佳，會發生什麼事?
options: The shutoff will be moved to November 12
The shutoff will be extended until the evening
The shutoff will begin earlier in the morning
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到若大雨使施工不安全，停水將改到11月12日星期四，時間相同，並非取消、延長或提早，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: What is NOT mentioned in the notice?
questions.question_zh: 關於這則公告，下列何者沒有被提到?
options: Water may look cloudy after service returns.
Free bottled water will be offered at a fire station.
Customers with registered mobile numbers will receive text updates.
Affected customers will receive a credit on their bills.
questions.explanation_zh: 公告提到水可能暫時混濁、消防站提供免費瓶裝水、已登記手機的客戶會收到簡訊通知，但完全沒有提到帳單減免，因此未被提到的是帳單折抵，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: The word "restored" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "restored" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "When service is restored" 指供水「恢復」，與 "brought back" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (B)。

passages.title: Letter: Winter Supply Program Invitation

meta.label: From:
meta.value: Rosalind Achterberg, Millstone Valley Growers Cooperative

paragraphs: Dear Chef Rahimi,

Thank you for visiting our stand at the Riverside Food Fair. On behalf of Millstone Valley Growers Cooperative, a group of fourteen family farms within sixty miles of the city, I am pleased to invite Saltmarsh Kitchen to join our Winter Supply Program.

The program runs for fifteen weeks, from the week of November 16 through Friday, February 26, with one delivery each Tuesday morning before 7:00. Two crate sizes are available. The Basic crate, $62 per week, contains kale, carrots, beets, potatoes, and onions. The Premium crate, $85 per week, includes everything in the Basic crate plus winter squash, mushrooms, and fresh herbs. Restaurants ordering four or more crates per week receive $25 off the weekly total.
To lock in these prices for the entire season, please return the signed agreement to our office by November 6. After that date, prices may change to reflect the harvest.
We look forward to supplying your kitchen.

Sincerely,
Rosalind Achterberg
Sales Director, Millstone Valley Growers Cooperative

passages.title: Memo: Winter Produce Deliveries
paragraphs: As you know, we have signed up for the Winter Supply Program with Millstone Valley Growers Cooperative. We ordered four crates each week: three Premium and one Basic. The first delivery will arrive on Tuesday, November 17, and every Tuesday after that. The driver will reach the back door at about 6:45 a.m., so the opening cook on Tuesdays must be in the kitchen by 6:30 to receive and check the crates.

Please keep the following in mind. The top two shelves of the walk-in cooler will be reserved for the crates, so rotate older stock to the front. Report any damaged vegetables to me the same day so that I can request a credit from the cooperative.

Because mushrooms and winter squash will now be available every week, I am designing a new winter menu that will launch on November 20. Please attend the tasting on Thursday, November 12, at 3:00 p.m. to try the first dishes.
Thank you for your help with this change.
Hamid Rahimi

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the letter?
questions.question_zh: 這封信的目的為何?
options: To announce the closing of the cooperative's farms
To request payment for an earlier order
To advertise the Riverside Food Fair
To invite a restaurant to join a seasonal supply program
questions.explanation_zh: 信中表示邀請 Saltmarsh Kitchen 加入合作社的冬季供貨計畫，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: What does the Premium crate include that the Basic crate does not?
questions.question_zh: 高級箱含有哪些基本箱沒有的內容?
options: Winter squash, mushrooms, and fresh herbs
questions.explanation_zh: 信中說明高級箱包含基本箱的所有品項，再加上冬南瓜、菇類與新鮮香草；甘藍、紅蘿蔔、甜菜、馬鈴薯、洋蔥則是兩種箱子都有，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: What is NOT stated about Millstone Valley Growers Cooperative in the letter?
questions.question_zh: 關於 Millstone Valley Growers Cooperative，信中沒有提到下列何者?
options: It is made up of fourteen family farms
It offers a discount for larger orders
It delivers produce twice a week
It had a stand at a food fair
questions.explanation_zh: 信中提到合作社由十四個家庭農場組成、四箱以上有折扣、並在美食展設攤，但送貨是每週二一次，並非每週兩次，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: How much will Saltmarsh Kitchen pay the cooperative each week?
questions.question_zh: Saltmarsh Kitchen 每週要付給合作社多少錢?
questions.explanation_zh: 備忘錄指出每週訂三箱高級箱與一箱基本箱，即 3 × 85 + 62 = 317 美元；共四箱符合折扣條件，信中說明可折25美元，所以是 317 − 25 = 292 美元，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: When will the first delivery arrive at Saltmarsh Kitchen?
questions.question_zh: Saltmarsh Kitchen 第一次會在何時收到貨?
questions.explanation_zh: 信中說計畫從11月16日當週開始、每週二送貨，備忘錄也確認首次送貨為週二11月17日；11月12日是試吃會，11月20日是新菜單上市日，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: What can be inferred about Chef Rahimi's agreement with the cooperative?
questions.question_zh: 關於 Rahimi 主廚與合作社的協議，可以推論出什麼?
options: It was finalized before the price-lock deadline
It includes deliveries twice a week
It was arranged through a wholesaler
questions.explanation_zh: 信中規定須在11月6日前交回簽署協議才能鎖定價格，而11月2日的備忘錄已說「我們已簽約」，可見是在期限前完成；計畫為每週一次送貨並持續到2月26日，且是直接與合作社簽約，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Willowmere Family Dental – Fall Smile Savings
paragraphs: Willowmere Family Dental invites new patients to start the season with a healthier smile. From November 9 through December 18, anyone who books a first visit will receive a complete exam, digital X-rays, and a professional cleaning for just $79. The regular price for these services is $220.

Current patients can enjoy savings as well. Refer a friend or family member who completes a new-patient visit, and you will receive a $30 credit toward your next treatment. Credits cannot be redeemed for cash and expire on March 31. Teeth whitening is also discounted: take 20 percent off any whitening package when you purchase it during the same visit as a cleaning.

To qualify for the $79 offer, you must not have visited our clinic within the past two years. Patients with dental insurance may still use their coverage for any additional treatment recommended after the exam. Children under 12 are welcome and will receive a free toothbrush set.

We are open Monday through Thursday from 8:30 A.M. to 6:00 P.M. and Saturday from 9:00 A.M. to 1:00 P.M. Evening appointments fill quickly, so we recommend booking at least one week in advance at www.willowmeredental.example or by calling 555-0142.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the advertisement?
questions.question_zh: 這則廣告的目的為何？
options: To announce the opening of a new clinic location
To promote special offers for new and current patients
To explain changes to insurance coverage
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告開頭邀請新病患以優惠價格就診，後文又介紹現有病患的推薦回饋與美白折扣，可見其目的是推廣針對新舊病患的優惠，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: How much can a new patient save on the first visit during the promotion?
questions.question_zh: 促銷期間，新病患的首次就診可以省下多少錢？
questions.explanation_zh: 第一段指出首次就診原價為 $220、優惠價為 $79，220 − 79 = 141，所以可省下 $141，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What is NOT included in the $79 first-visit offer?
questions.question_zh: 下列哪一項「不」包含在 79 美元的首次就診優惠中？
questions.explanation_zh: 第一段說明 $79 包含完整檢查、數位 X 光與專業洗牙；美白方案在第二段是另外購買才享 8 折，並不包含在內，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: Who would most likely be eligible for the $79 offer?
questions.question_zh: 下列哪一位最有可能符合 79 美元優惠的資格？
options: A resident who last had a cleaning at the clinic three years ago
A patient who visited the clinic last spring
A patient who had an exam at the clinic 14 months ago
A patient who was treated at the clinic in January of this year
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段規定，必須在過去兩年內未曾到該診所就診才符合資格。三年前就診已超過兩年，符合條件；其餘三位（去年春天、14 個月前、今年一月）都在兩年內來過，不符資格，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Notice: New Borrowing Rules at Larchmont Public Library
paragraphs: Larchmont Public Library will introduce updated borrowing rules at all three of its locations beginning Monday, November 30. The changes are designed to shorten waiting lists for popular titles and to make renewals easier for our members.

Under the new rules, each library card holder may check out up to 15 books and up to 3 DVDs at one time. The current limits are 10 books and 5 DVDs. Titles marked "Quick Pick" on the shelf, which are new releases in high demand, may be borrowed for 14 days and cannot be renewed. All other books will keep the 21-day loan period and may be renewed online up to two times, provided that no other patron has placed a hold on them.

Overdue fines for children's books will be eliminated. Fines for all other materials will remain $0.20 per day, up to a maximum of $10 per item. Items checked out before November 30 will keep their original due dates and will not be affected by the new rules.

Please note that cardholders with an outstanding balance of $15 or more will be unable to borrow additional items until the balance is paid. Updated brochures will be available at the front desk of each location from November 16.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the notice?
questions.question_zh: 這則公告的目的為何？
options: To announce a temporary closure of the library
To invite residents to a community event
To inform members of changes to borrowing rules
To request donations of books and DVDs
questions.explanation_zh: 公告開頭即說明圖書館將自 11 月 30 日起實施新的借閱規則，後文逐項說明借書上限、借期與罰款，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: By how many will the book limit per cardholder increase?
questions.question_zh: 每位持卡人的借書上限將增加多少本？
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段指出新上限為 15 本，目前上限為 10 本，15 − 10 = 5，因此增加 5 本，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Which of the following items most likely cannot be renewed?
questions.question_zh: 下列哪一項資料最有可能無法續借？
options: A classic novel with no holds waiting
A gardening book borrowed for 21 days
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段說明標示 "Quick Pick" 的熱門新書借期 14 天且不可續借；其他一般書籍（包含經典小說、園藝書與兒童繪本）在無人預約時都可線上續借，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: The word "outstanding" in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第四段中的 "outstanding" 一字，意思最接近下列哪一個？
questions.explanation_zh: "outstanding balance" 指「尚未繳清的欠款」，與 unpaid 意思最接近；excellent 與 impressive 是「傑出」的意思，不符語境，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Marlowe & Finch Publishing – Examination Copy Request Form
paragraphs: Title requested: Writing for the Workplace, 4th edition (list price $90.00). Format: one print copy with 60-day online access to the companion exercises. Expected enrollment: 28 students in the spring semester, which begins January 11. Ship to: Department of Business Studies, Calder Community College, 1200 Mill Road.

Terms: Examination copies are provided for evaluation purposes. Instructors who adopt the book for a course with 20 or more enrolled students may keep the copy at no cost. Instructors who do not adopt the book must either return the copy to Marlowe & Finch by January 15 using the prepaid label enclosed, or pay the invoice, which will be issued at the list price less a 40 percent educator discount.

Please allow 5 to 7 business days for delivery. Requests submitted without a department mailing address cannot be processed. By signing below, the requester confirms that she is an instructor currently teaching at the institution listed above.
Signature: Anita Desrosiers

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the form?
questions.question_zh: 這份表單的目的為何?
options: To place a bulk order for classroom textbooks
To apply for a publishing job
To request a sample textbook for course evaluation
questions.explanation_zh: 表單標題為審閱樣書申請表，教授申請一本教科書供課程評估使用，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: What must Professor Desrosiers do to keep the copy at no cost?
questions.question_zh: Desrosiers 教授要怎麼做才能免費保留樣書?
options: Adopt the book for a course of at least 20 students
Return a signed form by November 20
Write a review for the publisher
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段規定採用此書於20人以上課程的教師可免費保留樣書，其他選項在表單中都沒有提到，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: How much will Calder Community College be charged if the copy is neither adopted nor returned by January 15?
questions.question_zh: 如果1月15日前既未採用也未寄回樣書，Calder Community College 會被收取多少費用?
questions.explanation_zh: 未採用也未寄回者須依定價扣除40%教育優惠付款，90美元 × 0.6 = 54美元；36美元是折扣金額而非應付金額，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: The word "adopt" in the second paragraph is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "adopt" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "adopt the book for a course" 指「選用此書作為課程教材」，與 "choose to use" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (B)。

passages.title: Lumen Photography Studio – Holiday Portrait Packages
paragraphs: Capture this year's holiday memories with a professional portrait session at Lumen Photography Studio. Choose from three packages.

Classic – $85: 30-minute session, one backdrop, and 5 digital images. Family – $140: 45-minute session, two backdrops, up to 8 people, 10 digital images, and one 8x10 print. Deluxe – $220: 60-minute session, three backdrops, 20 digital images, and a framed 11x14 print. With any package, additional digital images cost $12 each.
Book by November 6 and receive 20 percent off the package price (additional images are not discounted). Digital images are delivered within seven days of the session.
Reserve your time at www.lumenphoto.com or call (555) 012-6408. A $25 deposit holds your time slot and will be applied to your final balance. Rescheduling is free up to 48 hours before the session.

passages.title: E-mail: Question About Family Portrait Session
paragraphs: Hello,

I saw your holiday portrait advertisement and would like to book a session for my family. There will be six of us, including my parents. We would like a session of about 45 minutes, and we need 14 digital images in total so that each relative can have a few. We do not need a framed print.

Could you tell me which package makes the most sense? I would like to book this week so that I can still take advantage of the discount, and I can pay the deposit online today. Our preferred date is Saturday, December 5, in the late morning if possible, since my children tend to be calmer earlier in the day. Please let me know whether that time is available and when I should expect to receive the digital images after the session.

Thank you,
Priya Nair

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the advertisement?
questions.question_zh: 這則廣告的目的為何?
options: To promote portrait photography packages for the holidays
To announce the opening of a new photography school
To recruit photographers for the holiday season
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告介紹節慶期間三種人像攝影方案與預約優惠，目的是推廣節慶人像攝影方案，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: What is NOT included in the Family package?
questions.question_zh: Family 方案不包含下列何者?
options: A session for up to eight people
questions.explanation_zh: Family 方案包含最多8人、45分鐘拍攝與一張8x10照片；裱框的11x14照片是 Deluxe 方案才有的內容，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: Why did Ms. Nair write the e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 為什麼奈兒女士要寫這封電子郵件?
options: To complain about the quality of her photographs
To ask which package to choose before booking
To cancel a session on December 5
To request a refund of a deposit
questions.explanation_zh: 她說明家人人數、拍攝時間與所需照片數量，詢問哪個方案最合適，並打算在本週預約，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: How much will Ms. Nair pay for the package and additional images, if she books by the deadline?
questions.question_zh: 如果奈兒女士在期限內預約，方案與額外照片總共要付多少錢?
questions.explanation_zh: 她適合 Family 方案(人數6人、含10張數位照片)，打8折後為112美元；她需要14張，多出4張，每張12美元共48美元(不打折)，112加48等於160美元；188美元是忘了折扣的結果，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: Which package would cost Ms. Nair less for 14 digital images, and by how much?
questions.question_zh: 若要取得14張數位照片，奈兒女士選哪個方案花費較少，少多少?
questions.explanation_zh: Family 方案為112加48共160美元；Deluxe 方案含20張，打8折為176美元；176減160等於16美元，所以 Family 方案較便宜、少16美元，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: The phrase "take advantage of" in the e-mail is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 電子郵件中的 "take advantage of" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "take advantage of the discount" 指「利用」折扣優惠，與 "make use of" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (D)。

passages.title: Notice to Customers: Prescription Pickup Lockers at Bellwood Pharmacy
paragraphs: Beginning Monday, December 7, Bellwood Pharmacy will offer secure prescription pickup lockers at our front entrance. The lockers will be accessible 24 hours a day, seven days a week, so customers no longer need to arrive during store hours to collect their refills.

To use the service, select the "locker pickup" option when you request a refill online, through our mobile app, or by phone. When your prescription is ready, you will receive a text message with a six-digit code. Enter the code on the locker keypad to open your assigned door. No photo identification is required. Codes remain valid for seven days. Any prescription not collected within that time will be returned to the pharmacy's stock, and you will need to submit a new request.

Please note that medications being started for the first time, as well as certain controlled substances, cannot be placed in the lockers. Our pharmacists must review these with you in person, so they will continue to be available only at the pharmacy counter.
Customers may register for text alerts beginning Monday, November 16, at the counter or on our Web site. If you have questions, call 555-0142 or ask any member of our pharmacy team.

questions.question_en: What is the main purpose of the notice?
questions.question_zh: 這則公告的主要目的為何?
options: To announce the closing of the pharmacy
To announce a new way to pick up prescriptions
To report a recall of a medication
questions.explanation_zh: 公告開頭即說明將於12月7日起提供處方箋取藥置物櫃，通篇都在介紹這項新服務，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: When will the pickup lockers become available?
questions.question_zh: 取藥置物櫃何時開始提供使用?
questions.explanation_zh: 第一段寫明從12月7日星期一開始；11月8日是公告張貼日，11月16日是開放登記文字通知的日期，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will happen to a prescription left in a locker for more than seven days?
questions.question_zh: 放在置物櫃超過七天的處方藥會如何處理?
options: It will be returned to the pharmacy's stock
It will be mailed to the customer
It will be donated to a clinic
It will be moved to the drive-through window
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段說明代碼有效期為七天，超過期限未領取的藥品會退回藥局庫存，顧客需重新提出申請，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: What is suggested about customers who start a new medication?
questions.question_zh: 關於開始服用新藥的顧客，公告暗示了什麼?
options: They cannot use the pharmacy's online refill service
They will be charged an extra fee
They must wait seven days before pickup
They must receive pharmacist counseling at the counter
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段指出首次開始服用的藥物不能放入置物櫃，因為藥師必須當面說明，可見這類顧客須到櫃檯接受藥師講解，因此答案是 (D)。

passages.title: Aerowind Airways – Delayed Baggage Report Form

meta.label: Flight:
meta.value: AW 318, Portland to Chicago (connecting in Denver)

paragraphs: Mr. Pillai arrived at Chicago O'Hare Airport on November 2 at 6:40 p.m. One checked bag, a black hard-shell suitcase with baggage tag AW553902, did not arrive on the flight.

Contents: business clothing, toiletries, a laptop charger, and a phone charger. Passenger statement: "I am attending a three-day training seminar beginning tomorrow morning and need my business clothing and chargers."
Delivery address for the bag: Hotel Marden, 220 Lake Street, Chicago, Room 1412 (guest through November 5). Contact: Naveen Pillai, mobile 555-0187.
The passenger understands that receipts for essential items purchased because of the delay must be kept and submitted with a reimbursement request.
Received by: Aerowind Baggage Services Desk, O'Hare Airport

passages.title: E-mail: Delayed Baggage Report DB-60418
paragraphs: Dear Mr. Pillai,
I am pleased to confirm that your suitcase was located in Denver and delivered to Hotel Marden on November 4. Please accept our apologies for the inconvenience.

Thank you for sending your receipts for a toothbrush set and toiletries ($38.50), a dress shirt ($52.00), and a phone charger ($29.50), which total $120.00. All three purchases qualify as essential items under our policy. Because your suitcase reached you two days after your arrival, your claim covers two days of delay.
If you have any additional receipts, you may still send them through the baggage page of our Web site. Approved payments are made by bank transfer.

Sincerely,
Dana Whitfield
Baggage Services, Aerowind Airways

passages.title: Aerowind Airways – Delayed Baggage Compensation
paragraphs: If your checked bag has not reached you within 12 hours of your flight's arrival, please report it at the airport before leaving the terminal or online within 24 hours.

We reimburse reasonable receipts for essential items, such as toiletries, basic clothing, and phone chargers, up to $50 for each full day of delay, with a maximum of $150 per bag. Items such as alcohol, jewelry, and entertainment purchases are not eligible.
Receipts must be submitted within 14 days after the bag is returned to the passenger. Approved claims are paid by bank transfer within 10 business days.
If a bag is not found within five days, the passenger will be asked to file a lost-baggage claim, which follows separate rules.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the first document?
questions.question_zh: 第一份文件的目的為何?
options: To report a bag that did not arrive with a passenger
To request a seat change on a flight
To apply for a frequent-flyer card
questions.explanation_zh: 表單標題為延誤行李報告表，內容記載乘客的行李未隨班機抵達，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the form, where should the suitcase be delivered?
questions.question_zh: 根據表單，行李箱應送到哪裡?
questions.explanation_zh: 表單的送達地址欄寫明是 Hotel Marden 的 1412 號房，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: Why did Ms. Whitfield send the e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 為什麼 Whitfield 女士要寄這封電子郵件?
options: To ask Mr. Pillai to file a lost-baggage claim
To confirm the return of a bag and the status of a claim
To announce a new baggage fee
questions.explanation_zh: 信中確認行李已於11月4日送到飯店，並說明他的收據符合補償資格；行李已找到，因此不需要提出遺失行李申請，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: How much will Mr. Pillai most likely be reimbursed for his purchases?
questions.question_zh: Pillai 先生的採購費用最可能獲得多少補償?
questions.explanation_zh: 電子郵件說明延誤兩天且收據總額為120美元；網頁規定每延誤一個整天最高補償50美元，兩天即100美元，低於收據總額，所以補償100美元；150美元是每件行李的上限，並非此案金額，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: What is the last date on which Mr. Pillai can submit additional receipts?
questions.question_zh: Pillai 先生最晚可在哪一天提交額外的收據?
questions.explanation_zh: 網頁規定須在行李歸還後14天內提交收據，電子郵件指出行李於11月4日送達，11月4日加14天為11月18日；11月16日是從回報日起算的錯誤算法，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: Which purchase would NOT be eligible for reimbursement?
questions.question_zh: 下列哪一項購買不符合補償資格?
questions.explanation_zh: 網頁明確列出酒精類商品不予補償，而牙膏、手機充電器與基本衣物都屬於必需品，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: The word "eligible" in the Web page is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 網頁中的 "eligible" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "not eligible" 指「不符合資格」，與 "qualified"（有資格的）意思最接近；"refunded" 是已退款，並非資格之意，因此答案是 (B)。

passages.title: Letter: Loan of Navigation Instruments to Halvorsen Maritime Museum
paragraphs: Dear Mr. Ndiaye,

Thank you for generously agreeing to lend your collection of nineteenth-century brass sextants and chronometers for our spring exhibition, Charting the Coast, which will run from March 6 through June 28. I am writing to outline the next steps.

Our conservation team will visit your home on January 12 to photograph and assess each item. We expect the visit to take about three hours. A professional art-handling company will then collect the pieces on February 9. Please note that our insurer requires a signed loan agreement and an updated valuation for each item before transport. The agreement is enclosed; kindly sign it and return it by January 30. If you prefer, the museum's appraiser can complete the valuations at no cost to you.

We would also like to include a short biography of you in the exhibition catalog and to display your name on the introductory panel, unless you wish to remain anonymous. Please let me know your preference by the same date.
Sincerely,
Ingrid Solheim
Chief Curator, Halvorsen Maritime Museum

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the letter?
questions.question_zh: 這封信的目的為何?
options: To invite Mr. Ndiaye to a museum fundraiser
To request a donation of artifacts
To explain the next steps for borrowing his collection
To announce a change in exhibition dates
questions.explanation_zh: 信中感謝對方同意出借收藏，並說明後續步驟（勘查、取件、簽約等），因此是說明借展的後續流程，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: How much time will pass between the conservation visit and the pickup of the items?
questions.question_zh: 從保存團隊到府勘查到物品被取走，中間相隔多久?
questions.explanation_zh: 勘查日為 1 月 12 日，取件日為 2 月 9 日；1 月有 31 天，1 月 12 日再加 28 天正好是 2 月 9 日，也就是相隔四週，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: What is Mr. Ndiaye asked to do by January 30?
questions.question_zh: Ndiaye 先生被要求在 1 月 30 日前做什麼?
options: Sign and return the loan agreement
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段請他在 1 月 30 日前簽署並寄回借展合約，估價由博物館鑑定人免費處理，搬運公司也由博物館安排，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "assess" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第三段中的 "assess" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "photograph and assess each item" 指拍照並「評估」每件物品，與 evaluate 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Notice to Passengers: Check-In Counter Relocation
paragraphs: Riverton Regional Airport announces that, beginning Monday, November 23, all check-in counters for Aerolane and Brightwing Airlines will move from Terminal 1 to the newly renovated East Hall of Terminal 2. Passengers whose flights depart before that date should continue to check in at Terminal 1.

Passengers will be dropped off on Level 2 of Terminal 2, where self-service kiosks and baggage drop are located. Security screening for these airlines will take place at the Terminal 2 checkpoint, which opens at 4:00 a.m. daily. During the first week, from November 23 to November 29, we expect heavy crowds. Passengers on flights departing before 9:00 a.m. are therefore advised to arrive three hours before departure instead of the usual two hours.

A free shuttle bus will run every 10 minutes between the two terminals from 4:00 a.m. until midnight, and the ride takes about five minutes. Parking in the Terminal 1 garage remains available, and the first 20 minutes in the Terminal 2 drop-off lane are free. Passengers who need wheelchair assistance should request it at least 24 hours before their flight by calling the airport help desk at (555) 016-2290.

questions.question_en: Why was the notice written?
questions.question_zh: 為什麼要發布這則公告?
options: To announce an increase in parking fees
To inform passengers that check-in counters are moving
questions.explanation_zh: 公告說明自11月23日起兩家航空公司的報到櫃檯將從 Terminal 1 搬到 Terminal 2，目的是通知旅客報到地點的更動，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What is indicated about a passenger flying with Aerolane on November 20?
questions.question_zh: 關於11月20日搭乘 Aerolane 的旅客，文中提到什麼?
options: The passenger must use the shuttle bus to check in.
The passenger will check in at Terminal 1.
The passenger should arrive three hours early.
The passenger will be screened at Terminal 2.
questions.explanation_zh: 第一段指出11月23日之前出發的旅客仍在 Terminal 1 報到，11月20日早於11月23日，因此仍在 Terminal 1 報到，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: A passenger has an 8:00 a.m. Aerolane flight on Wednesday, November 25. By what time is she advised to arrive at the airport?
questions.question_zh: 一位旅客搭乘11月25日(週三)上午8:00的 Aerolane 班機，建議她幾點前抵達機場?
questions.explanation_zh: 11月25日落在11月23日至29日的第一週，且班機在上午9點前起飛，建議提前三小時抵達，8:00減三小時是5:00 a.m.；6:00 a.m. 是一般提前兩小時的時間，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: The word "advised" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "advised" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "are advised to arrive three hours before" 指「被建議」提前三小時抵達，與 "recommended" 意思最接近，並非強制要求，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Cascadia Auto Care – Vehicle Service Work Order
paragraphs: Services requested: front brake pad replacement, engine oil and filter change, and cabin air filter replacement.
Estimate: Parts – front brake pads $120.00; oil and oil filter $40.00; cabin air filter $35.00. Labor – 3 hours at $85.00 per hour. Estimated total: $450.00 (tax included).

Authorization: By signing below, the customer authorizes the work listed above. Any additional repair that would raise the total by more than $100.00 will not be performed until the customer gives approval by telephone or e-mail. Vehicles not collected within three days of completion will be charged a storage fee of $10.00 per day.

Notes: The customer asked that the old brake pads be returned after replacement. The shop will provide a courtesy shuttle to the Harbor Street train station on request. Please present a photo ID when collecting the vehicle.
Customer signature: H. Lim

passages.title: E-mail: Work Order 20817 – Approval Needed
paragraphs: Dear Mr. Lim,

While replacing the front brake pads on your Calder hatchback, our technician noticed that the rear brake rotors are worn below the manufacturer's minimum thickness. We recommend replacing them for your safety. The additional parts and labor would cost $210.00, bringing the total for your visit to $660.00.

Because this amount exceeds the limit stated on your work order, we cannot proceed without your approval. Please reply to this e-mail or call me at 555-0166 by 5:00 P.M. today. If you approve, the rotors will arrive tomorrow, and because our shop is closed on Sundays, the car would be ready on Monday, November 9. If you prefer not to replace the rotors at this time, your car will be ready for pickup this evening as originally scheduled.
Sincerely,
Priya Nandakumar, Service Manager

questions.question_en: How much is the labor charge on the work order?
questions.question_zh: 工作單上的工資為多少?
questions.explanation_zh: 工作單載明工資為 3 小時、每小時 $85，所以是 3 × 85 = $255，因此 $450 是預估總額而非工資，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: Why did Ms. Nandakumar write to Mr. Lim?
questions.question_zh: Nandakumar 女士為什麼寫信給 Lim 先生?
options: To report that his car has been stolen
To invite him to a customer event
To ask for approval of an additional repair
questions.explanation_zh: 信中說明技師發現後煞車碟盤磨損，建議更換，並請他在期限前回覆是否同意，因此是要求核准額外維修，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: Why did the shop need to contact Mr. Lim before replacing the rotors?
questions.question_zh: 為什麼店家在更換碟盤前必須聯絡 Lim 先生?
options: The brake pads were out of stock
The extra repair exceeds the amount allowed without approval
Mr. Lim missed the pickup date
The shop wanted to change its labor rate
questions.explanation_zh: 工作單規定追加維修若使總額增加超過 $100，須經客戶同意；碟盤的追加費用為 $210，超過上限，所以必須先取得同意，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will the total cost be if Mr. Lim approves the rotor replacement?
questions.question_zh: 若 Lim 先生同意更換碟盤，總費用會是多少?
questions.explanation_zh: 原預估 $450 再加上碟盤費用 $210，總計 $660，電子郵件中也明確寫出此金額，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: When will the car be ready if Mr. Lim approves the additional repair?
questions.question_zh: 若 Lim 先生同意額外維修，車子何時可以取車?
questions.explanation_zh: 電子郵件指出若同意，零件明天到貨，而店休星期日，因此車子會在 11 月 9 日星期一完成，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: The word "approval" in the e-mail is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 電子郵件中的 "approval" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "we cannot proceed without your approval" 指沒有你的「同意」就無法進行，與 authorization（授權、許可）意思最接近，因此答案是 (D)。

passages.title: Memo: New Access Rules at the Marina Heights Construction Site

meta.label: From:
meta.value: Stefan Kowalczyk, Site Safety Manager, Tallgrass Builders

paragraphs: To ensure the safety of everyone at the Marina Heights residential tower project, the following changes to site access will take effect on Monday, November 16.

First, the Pier Street gate will open at 6:30 A.M. instead of 6:00 A.M. and will close at 5:00 P.M. Everyone entering the site, including delivery drivers, must sign in at the security trailer and wear a hard hat, safety vest, and steel-toed boots. Visitors must be accompanied by a member of the Tallgrass staff at all times.

Second, the north parking area will be closed to vehicles on Tuesdays and Thursdays so that the tower crane can lift materials. On those days, workers should use the shuttle service from the Dock Street lot, which will run every 15 minutes.

Finally, each subcontractor must submit a list of all employees who will work on site to me by Friday, November 13. Workers whose names are not on the list will not be admitted until their information has been verified. Thank you for your cooperation.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the memo?
questions.question_zh: 這份備忘錄的目的為何?
options: To announce the completion of the tower project
To announce new site access rules
To introduce a new safety manager
questions.explanation_zh: 備忘錄開頭即說明自 11 月 16 日起工地出入管理將有所變動，內容皆為新的進出規定，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: How much later will the Pier Street gate open starting November 16?
questions.question_zh: 從 11 月 16 日起，Pier Street 大門的開啟時間會晚多久?
questions.explanation_zh: 大門開啟時間由早上 6:00 改為 6:30，所以晚了 30 分鐘，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What must subcontractors do by November 13?
questions.question_zh: 分包商必須在 11 月 13 日前做什麼?
options: Submit a list of their on-site employees
Move their vehicles to the Dock Street lot
Sign in at the security trailer
questions.explanation_zh: 最後一段要求各分包商在 11 月 13 日星期五前，將在工地工作的所有員工名單交給 Kowalczyk 先生，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: What is suggested about Wednesdays?
questions.question_zh: 關於星期三，文中暗示了什麼?
options: The site will be closed to all workers
The tower crane will not operate
The shuttle service will run every 30 minutes
Workers can park in the north parking area
questions.explanation_zh: 北側停車場只在星期二與星期四因吊車作業而禁止車輛進入，可推知星期三工人仍可使用該停車場，因此答案是 (D)。

passages.title: Tallyroom Project Software – Year-End Subscription Offer
paragraphs: Keep every project, deadline, and client request in one place with Tallyroom, the cloud-based project software built for small and mid-sized teams. From now until November 30, you can save 20 percent on any plan when you choose annual billing instead of monthly billing.

Starter: $12 per user per month, up to 5 users, with task lists and shared calendars. Team: $20 per user per month, up to 25 users, adding time tracking and client progress reports. Business: $34 per user per month, unlimited users, adding priority phone support and custom dashboards. Prices shown are monthly rates before the annual-billing discount.

New customers can try any plan free for 30 days, and no credit card is required. Customers who currently pay monthly may switch to annual billing at any time, and the unused portion of the current month will be credited to the new invoice. Our onboarding team will import your existing spreadsheet data at no charge for Team and Business subscribers.

Annual subscriptions renew automatically on the anniversary date. To avoid being charged for another year, cancel at least seven days before the renewal date through your account settings. For questions, write to sales@tallyroom-app.com or chat with us on our website.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the advertisement?
questions.question_zh: 這則廣告的目的為何?
options: To announce a new office location
To promote a discount on yearly software subscriptions
To explain a change in a company's privacy policy
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告開頭說明在11月30日前選擇年繳可享八折優惠，並介紹各方案與費用，目的是推廣軟體的年度訂閱折扣，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: A company with 10 employees subscribes to the Team plan with annual billing during the offer. What will its monthly cost be?
questions.question_zh: 一間有10名員工的公司在優惠期間以年繳方式訂閱 Team 方案，每月費用為多少?
questions.explanation_zh: Team 方案每位使用者每月20美元，10人為200美元；年繳可省20%，200乘以0.8等於160美元，200美元是未打折的月費，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What is indicated about the Starter plan?
questions.question_zh: 關於 Starter 方案，文中提到什麼?
options: It is limited to five users.
It comes with priority phone support.
It is available only to new customers.
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段寫明 Starter 方案最多5位使用者；時間追蹤屬於 Team 方案，優先電話支援屬於 Business 方案，文中也未限定只有新客戶可用，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: What must a customer do to avoid being charged for another year?
questions.question_zh: 客戶必須怎麼做才不會被收取下一年的費用?
options: Switch to monthly billing in November
Contact the onboarding team by phone
Delete all project data from the account
Cancel at least seven days before the renewal date
questions.explanation_zh: 第四段指出年度訂閱會自動續約，若不想被收取下一年費用，須在續約日前至少七天取消，因此答案是 (D)。
